nodes.description: Mechanical compression of the vertebral artery by adjacent bone is a non-atherosclerotic, structural route to vertebral artery stenosis. Because the vessel traverses the cervical transverse foramina, osteophytes and other bony encroachment can narrow the lumen. The cited review establishes bony compression as one of several non-atherosclerotic stenosis etiologies; it does not characterize position-dependent or rotational compression, so no dynamic-compression claim is asserted here.
